column1: # Estimated CEFR levels — OURS, not a published wordlist.
# Produced 2026-07-26 by independent raters over the cards that carry no
# published level and sit at zipf >= 3.0. Calibrated first against 420 cards
# that DO carry one (six raters, blind): 38 % exact, 91 % within one step,
# 91 % on the 'core vocabulary or beyond' boundary — against 26 / 76 / 71 %
# for deriving the level from frequency, the rule `info/PLANS.md` pt.3
# Read that shape before using this file. The exact step is weak and the
# raters lean about a third of a level EASY. What is strong is the one
# boundary an official list attests, and on the Goethe half of the sample
# the estimate never once called a word 'core' that the list placed above.
# Per-level precision on words absent from the Goethe list (n=235): a1 83 %,
# a2 73 %, b2 39 %, c2 36 %, c1 26 %, b1 13 %. `b1` is the dumping ground.
# Consumed by vocab/levels.py into `cards.level_est` — never into `level`,
# and never into `band`, which picks one of 15 hand-painted brushes.
